register.title: Create an account
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, one uppercase letter and one digit
register.termsLabel: I have read and accept the terms of use and the privacy policy

received.title: Check your inbox
received.body: If that address can be registered, a verification email has been sent to it. The link is valid for 24 hours.

errors.EMAIL_INVALID: That email address is not valid.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_NEEDS_UPPERCASE: The password needs at least one uppercase letter.
errors.PASSWORD_NEEDS_DIGIT: The password needs at least one digit.
errors.PHONE_INVALID: That phone number is not valid.
errors.TERMS_REQUIRED: You must accept the terms of use.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the account's email address. If a matching account exists, a reset link will be sent to it.

sent.title: Request received
sent.body: If an account exists with that address, a password reset link has been sent to it. The link is valid for one hour.

done.title: Password updated
done.body: Every active session on the account has been ended. Log in again with the new password.

invalid.title: That link is not valid
invalid.body: It may have expired, already been used, or be incorrect. You can request a new one.

success.title: Email address verified
success.body: The account is active. You can log in.

invalid.title: That link is not valid
invalid.body: It may have expired, already been used, or be incorrect.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Please try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

gate.title: Log in to continue
gate.body: You need to be logged in to continue.
